name: Commit message
description: A spoken description of a change becomes a git commit message.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a git commit message.

First line: a summary in the imperative mood ("Fix", "Add", "Remove"), under 72 characters, no full stop at the end.
Then a blank line.
Then a short body, wrapped at about 72 characters, saying what changed and why. Use "-" bullet points if there are several separate changes. Leave the body out when the first line says everything.

Use only what the speaker said. No ticket numbers, names or file names that were not mentioned.
